request.deadline: three-month liquidity deployment after enactment with monthly reporting; exact full delivery deadline not stated in document
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with reserve-ratio mechanics and safety zones
Composable FIRE and ICE Cardano-native assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, asset supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, risk documentation, and launch-readiness review
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds to build and launch Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer with reserve architecture, FIRE/ICE assets, dashboards, adapters, reporting, audits, administration, and launch liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference rate for an approximately USD 2.0 million planning budget split into two approximately USD 1.0 million pools.

Pool 1 is intended for protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, deployed over three months in approximate tranches of USD 250,000, USD 250,000, and USD 500,000 after specified reviews and performance checks.

Pool 2 is intended for delivery, audits, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, administration, and go-to-market execution with itemized planning allocations totaling approximately USD 1.0 million.
Alchemy will use a shared BTC reserve backing FIRE and ICE, with reserve-ratio formulas, an initial 5.0x target reserve ratio, and safety zones above 4.0x, between 2.0x and 4.0x, and below 2.0x.
FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-upside asset and ICE as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset, both intended as composable Cardano-native primitives.
The proposer claims Cardano currently lacks a production BTCfi infrastructure layer and risks Bitcoin-backed structured exposure consolidating on other ecosystems.

The document cites public-market and on-chain Bitcoin-backed products, including Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, and Pendle, as evidence that demand for structured Bitcoin exposure is real and growing.

The proposer commits that profits, yield, and returns from treasury-supported launch liquidity will be returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly, while principal may be returned after Alchemy reaches a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million and governance approves a return action.

The proposal includes treasury protections such as fund separation, milestone gating, pause rules, refund conditions, ADA price protection above USD 0.35, administrator oversight, auto-abstain delegation for administrator-held ada, and a rollover clause if external investment funds development.

The proposer acknowledges risks from BTC volatility, oracle and bridge issues, Charms protocol-layer vulnerabilities, novel asset regulatory or user-understanding issues, delivery risk, and adoption risk, and lists mitigations including audits, modeling, staged launch, dashboards, disclosures, and pause rules.

summary: The document asks for 10,000,000 ada to fund a Cardano BTCfi infrastructure protocol, split between launch liquidity/infrastructure and delivery/audit/integration work, with several asserted treasury protections but externally checkable market-demand claims and incomplete independent validation in the supplied text.
